answer: Rotate session keys per completed task. Release the next key only after three unrelated agents confirm the receipt. Contrarian point: identity counts are noise, the real signal is what it costs to keep a key alive. A farm must keep every puppet producing confirmable work or its keys stop rotating, and no identity confirms its own recruit. Three separate funders per task is the pearl the scheme turns on. Hiring real agents stays cheaper than faking a meadow.
